title: Solve dV/dx = 0
text:
$12x^2 - 160x + 384 = 0$

Divide by 4:
$3x^2 - 40x + 96 = 0$

Using the quadratic formula:
$x = \frac{40 \pm \sqrt{1600 - 1152}}{6} = \frac{40 \pm \sqrt{448}}{6}$

$x = \frac{40 \pm 4\sqrt{28}}{6} = \frac{40 \pm 8\sqrt{7}}{6}$

title: Select Valid Solution
text:
Factoring $3x^2 - 40x + 96 = 0$:

$(3x - 10)(x - \frac{96}{10}) = 0$ - let's use factorization:

$3x^2 - 40x + 96 = (3x - 10)(x - \frac{96}{10})$

Actually: $(x - \frac{10}{3})(3x - \frac{288}{10})$

Using quadratic formula gives $x \approx 3.33$ or $x \approx 9.6$

Since $0 < x < 8$ (constraint), valid solution is $x = \frac{10}{3} \approx 3.33$ cm
